# CISA Campus Work Tracker

> Campus ministry contact management, outreach planning, and journey tracking application.

## Overview
CISA Campus Work Tracker provides tools for campus ministry teams to organize outreach, coordinate prayer requests, track attendance, and manage student journey stages.

## Links & Documentation
- [Privacy Policy](/docs/privacy.html): Information on data collection, storage, and privacy practices.
- [Support](/docs/support.html): Help and contact information for application users.
